summary: This 6-K filing by AstraZeneca announces EU regulatory approval of Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan) for first-line metastatic triple-negative breast cancer, based on TROPION-Breast02 Phase III results. It is a routine product approval announcement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, or capital restructuring is involved. The filing contains no deal terms, prices, or shareholder actions. The registrant acts only as the issuer disclosing regulatory news. Therefore, the appropriate classification is "None" as the event is an operational milestone, not a corporate special situation.
